verdict.rationale: Alloy documents configurable workflows, Journeys, and scheduled Portfolio workflows. The pack has no evidence of versioning those workflows, reviewing changes before they go live, or rolling back to a prior version. The API endpoint versioning and deprecation notices cover the API surface, not user automations, and "fully auditable agentic automation" describes auditability, not version control or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
